title: AI Engineer
description:
**Job Overview**

We are looking for a highly skilled and innovative **AI Engineer** with a minimum of **5 years of experience** to design, build, and deploy production-grade Artificial Intelligence and Large Language Model (LLM) architectures.In this role, you will lead the design of AI systems, optimize token usage and inference costs, and build advanced automated workflows. You will bridge the gap between traditional software engineering, cloud architecture, and cutting-edge generative AI models.

**Key Responsibilities**

* **AI Architecture & Design:** Create and review system blueprints, technical designs, and **AI artifacts** to ensure scalable, secure, and production-ready deployments.
* **Token & Cost Optimization:** Implement advanced optimization techniques for managing context windows, prompt compression, and **token cost optimization** across high-throughput LLM pipelines.
* **Workflow Automation:** Design and build complex, agentic AI workflows and integrations using orchestration engines like **n8n**.
* **Model Implementation:** Work deeply with state-of-the-art models (including Anthropic's **Claude Opus**, **Claude 3.5 Sonnet / Claude Code**) and specialized architectures like **Codex**, **Luna Terra**, and **Sol Astra**.
* **Cross-Functional Development:** Write high-performance backend code, integrate AI models into existing enterprise ecosystems, and maintain high standards of code quality.
* **DevOps & Infrastructure:** Manage version control, CI/CD pipelines, and collaborative workflows through **GitHub**, deploying applications natively onto the **Azure** cloud platform.

**Requirements & Qualifications**

* **Experience:** **Minimum 5+ years** of professional software engineering and AI systems development experience.
* **Core Languages:** Proficiency in high-performance and object-oriented programming with strong hands-on experience in **C++** and **Java**.
* **Cloud & DevOps:** Proven experience architecting and managing AI workloads on **Azure Cloud Services**, alongside advanced workflows using **GitHub**.
* **AI & LLM Technical Skills:**
* Strong familiarity with advanced prompt engineering, RAG (Retrieval-Augmented Generation), and **token tracking/budgeting**.
* Practical experience building automated nodes and workflows inside **n8n**.
* Deep understanding of modern code generation assistants (like **Claude Code**) and foundational code models.
* Familiarity or direct project exposure involving specialized frameworks or ecosystems like **Luna Terra** and **Sol Astra**.
* **Education:** Bachelor’s or Master’s degree in Computer Science, Data Science, AI, or a closely related quantitative field.

**Position Details**

* **Location:** **On-site at Janakpuri, New Delhi** *(Assuming alignment with previous role)*
* **Days & Hours:** **Monday to Saturday | 9:30 AM to 6:30 PM**
* **Employment Type:** Full-time

Pay: ₹1,000,000.00 - ₹1,500,000.00 per year

* Question: How many years of professional experience do you have in software engineering and AI systems development?
* Which language pair do you have strong backend production experience with?
* Have you built complex agentic workflows using n8n?
* In 2-3 sentences, explain your approach to token cost optimization in a high-throughput LLM application.
* Are you comfortable working full-time, fully on-site in Janakpuri, New Delhi, with a Monday to Saturday (9:30 AM – 6:30 PM) schedule?

title: Product Associate - Apprentice
description:
### **Description**

**About the Program**

The Eptura Apprenticeship Program is designed to provide recent graduates and early-career professionals with meaningful, hands-on experience within a global SaaS organization. Throughout this 12-month program, apprentices will receive mentoring, structured learning opportunities, and exposure to commercial operations and sales processes.

**Eligibility**

To be considered for this apprenticeship, candidates must:

* Have completed a Bachelor's degree within the past two years, OR
* Be in the final year of their degree program and eligible for apprenticeship participation
* Have no more than two years of professional work experience
* Be legally eligible to participate in an apprenticeship program in India

**Shape the Future of Work with Eptura**

At Eptura, we're not just another tech company—we're a global leader transforming the way people, workplaces, and assets connect. Our innovative worktech solutions empower 25 million users across 115 countries to thrive in a digitally connected world. Trusted by 45% of Fortune 500 companies, we're redefining workplace innovation and driving success for organizations around the globe.

**Role Overview**

As a Product Associate, you will work directly within our Gurugram engineering team, helping to shepherd product enhancements and customer-reported issues through Eptura's AI Development Lifecycle (AIDLC). You'll connect product priorities and engineering execution, keeping work organized, clearly specified, and moving forward on our Jira kanban boards.

This is a role for someone who is curious, organized, and eager to learn how great software products are built. You don't need prior experience in product management. You do need strong attention to detail, clear communication, demonstrated capabilities in using AI, and a genuine interest in how technology solves real-world problems.

### **Responsibilities**

  

* Manage and maintain the Jira kanban board: keeping tickets well-organized, clearly described, and appropriately prioritized in collaboration with engineering leads.
* Help triage incoming product enhancement requests and customer-reported defects, gathering the context engineers need to act on them.
* Work with AI to write clear, structured user stories and acceptance criteria that translate business needs into actionable engineering tasks.
* Coordinate with engineers to track progress, surface blockers, and ensure items move efficiently through the AIDLC stages.
* Participate in requirement-gathering conversations with product managers and stakeholders, capturing key decisions and open questions.
* Assist in drafting functional specifications and supporting documentation for new or enhanced product features, also working with AI.
* Support basic testing activities: reviewing completed work against acceptance criteria and flagging discrepancies.
* Contribute to ongoing improvement of our AIDLC processes and team ways of working.

  

### **About You**

We're looking for a motivated self-starter who is keen to build a career in product or technology. The following will set you up for success in this role:

* Strong written and verbal communication skills in English: you'll be writing tickets, specs, and summaries that engineers and stakeholders rely on.
* High attention to detail and a methodical approach to organizing information.
* Comfort working in a structured, process-driven environment: you like things to be clear, tracked, and accounted for.
* Curiosity about how software products are built and a willingness to ask questions.
* Familiarity with project or task management tools (Jira experience is a plus).
* A proactive mindset: you spot gaps, follow up, and take ownership of your work.
* Ability to work collaboratively in a fast-paced, cross-functional environment.
* Strong analytical skills with the ability to assess AI outputs, identify limitations or risks, and recommend improvements to enhance product value.
* AI-related experience:
* Understanding of AI fundamentals, including large language models (LLMs), prompt engineering, automation workflows, and responsible AI principles.
* Experience using AI tools to improve productivity: research, data analysis, content creation, or workflow automation, either through academic, personal, or professional projects. Ability to build and demonstrate an AI agent.
* Ability to evaluate Ai-driven product opportunities, gathering feedback and translating it into feature recommendations.

**Nice to Have**

* Exposure to agile or kanban workflows (even in an academic or personal project context).
* Basic understanding of software development concepts: you don't need to code, but knowing what engineers do helps.
* Prior internship, project, or coursework related to business analysis, product management, or software delivery.

  

### **Benefits**

  

* Monthly stipend
* Health Insurance fully paid – Self
* 13 Public Holidays
* Hyrid working policy
* Exposure to the latest trends and technologies in the SaaS industry.
* Mentorship from global experienced professionals in the sales, renewals and customer success fields.
* Potential for career advancement based on performance and dedication.

**Eptura Information:**

* Follow us on Twitter | LinkedIn | Facebook | YouTube
* At Eptura, we believe strong teams are built through collaboration, flexibility, and a range of perspectives grounded in skill and experience. We strive to create an environment where people can do their best work, contribute meaningfully, and grow alongside our business.

  

### **About Eptura**

Ready to make a difference? Explore opportunities with Eptura and join us on this incredible journey.  
  
Joining Eptura means becoming part of a forward-thinking, dynamic team that's on a mission to shape a better, more connected future. We're seeking passionate, driven individuals who want to make a real impact and be at the forefront of workplace innovation.

At Eptura, we believe strong teams are built through collaboration, flexibility, and a range of perspectives grounded in skill and experience. We strive to create an environment where people can do their best work, contribute meaningfully, and grow alongside our business.

description:

By applying ETAP solutions, customers experience continuous intelligence during design and engineering and into operations and maintenance using a unified electrical digital twin platform. ETAP supports customers in their digital transformation and sustainable energy transitions for a green and smart future, helping them to prioritize safety, maximize reliability, and stay resilient.**

**Our employees' passion for excellence, innovation, and customer satisfaction is our most-prized resource. If you share that passion — and want to be part of a company that leads the energy transition towards a cleaner and more resilient world for future generations — we invite you to join us!**

**ETAP is committed to creating a diverse work environment and is proud to be an Equal Opportunity Employer.**

**ETAP**

**JOB DESCRIPTION**

**Job Title:** Team Lead - R&D
  
**Location:** Delhi, India
  
**Employment Type:** Full-time

**The job**

We are looking for an R&D Technical Lead to lead software development and R&D activities for ETAP Real-Time products. The role focuses on SCADA, ADMS, real-time power-system applications, communication protocols, product testing, and engineering solutions. You will work closely with global R&D, Product Management, QA/Testing, and Project Engineering teams to develop innovative solutions, improve product quality, and address evolving market and customer requirements. This position will contribute to strengthening ETAP’s local R&D capabilities in India and supporting software localization and innovation initiatives.

**Key responsibilities**

* Lead and coordinate R&D and product development activities, providing technical guidance, reviewing solutions, mentoring developers, and resolving technical challenges.
* Coordinate verification and validation (V&V), functional, integration, and regression testing, ensuring defects and Incident Reports (IRs) are investigated, tracked, and resolved.
* Manage development tasks, testing activities, defects, and priorities in Jira, monitor progress against timelines, and communicate risks, blockers, and dependencies.
* Evaluate new technologies, communication protocols, and market requirements; develop proofs of concept (PoCs) and contribute to product performance, reliability, scalability, and usability improvements.
* Collaborate with global R&D, Product Management, QA/Testing, and Project Engineering teams on technical reviews, release planning, product demonstrations, troubleshooting, and technical documentation.

**Essential requirements**

* Bachelor’s or Master’s degree in Computer Science, Information Technology, Electrical Engineering, Electronics, Instrumentation, or a related technical field.
* Typically 3–6 years of relevant experience in software development, R&D, or engineering software, preferably involving SCADA, real-time systems, industrial automation, or power-system applications.
* Strong programming knowledge in C#, .NET, or .NET Framework; experience with software design, debugging, performance analysis, and system integration.
* Working knowledge of databases and development tools, including SQL, PostgreSQL or SQL Server, REST APIs, Git, and Visual Studio.
* Experience coordinating technical activities or guiding development teams, with good problem-solving, planning, communication, and team coordination skills.

**Desired skills and competencies**

* Knowledge of SCADA, EMS, DMS, OMS, ADMS, FEP, FLISR, real-time monitoring, HMI, alarms, events, trends, and historical data.
* Familiarity with industrial communication protocols such as OPC UA/DA, IEC 60870-5-104, DNP3, Modbus, and IEC 61850, along with power-system operation and protection fundamentals.
* Experience with V&V, product testing, Jira and Incident Report management, troubleshooting, root-cause analysis, and release coordination; knowledge of C++, Java, Python, Node.js, MongoDB, or AI/ML concepts is an advantage.
Demonstrates technical leadership, curiosity, and a continuous-improvement mindset, with a strong focus on innovation, customer impact, accountability, and collaboration across local and global teams.  

  

**ETAP requires all successful applicants to undergo and pass a comprehensive background check before they start employment. Background checks will be conducted in accordance with local laws and may, subject to those laws, include proof of educational attainment, employment history verification, proof of work authorization, criminal records, identity verification, credit check. Certain positions dealing with sensitive and/or third party personal data may involve additional background check criteria.**

**ETAP is an Equal Opportunity Employer. We are committed to being an exemplary employer with an inclusive culture, developing a workplace environment where all our employees are treated with dignity and respect. We value diversity and the expertise that people from different backgrounds bring to our business.**

**Come and join ETAP to create the transformative technology that enables our customers to engineer a better world.**

title: Senior Analyst, Incident Management
description:
Overview:
**WELCOME TO SITA**
-------------------

  

At SITA, we keep airports moving, airlines flying smoothly, and borders open. Our technology and communication innovations power the success of the global air travel industry.  

You'll find us in 95% of international airports, working closely with over 2,500 transportation and government clients. Each partnership brings unique challenges, and we thrive on delivering fresh solutions and cutting\-edge tech to keep operations running like clockwork. We don't just move the world forward\-we're proud to be recognized as a **Great Place to Work**® by 79% of our employees and certified in most of our growing locations. Here, we feel empowered, supported, and inspired to grow.  

Are you ready to love your job?  

The adventure begins right here, with you, at SITA.**PURPOSE**
-----------


Coordinates and oversees the resolution of critical incidents ensuring minimal business impact and swift restoration of services through structured processes and effective communication (and triggers crisis management process).**KEY RESPONSIBILITIES**
------------------------

* As Senior Analyst, Incident Management, you will serve as the operational control tower for Major Incidents and Priority 1 incidents across the Digital Customer Organization (DCO) and Portfolio Service Operations (PSO). You will establish command and control, coordinate the right technical and business resources, and maintain a disciplined focus on restoring customer services while minimizing operational, financial, reputational, and customer impact.
* You will be accountable for the quality and pace of end\-to\-end major incident governance, including impact assessment, stakeholder mobilization, technical and customer bridge management, escalation, communications, recovery validation, documentation, and post\-incident follow\-through. You will support the accountable Incident Manager and ensure that resolver teams retain ownership of technical diagnosis and remediation.
* Reporting to the Manager, Major Incident Management, you will be part of the Digital Customer Organization (DCO)function responsible for service resilience, customer confidence, consistent global incident response, and the continued transformation and maturity of Incident Management.
* You will collaborate with DCO Service Desks, PSO resolver teams, Customer Service Managers (CSO), Site Reliability Engineers (SRE), Service Practice Owners, Product and Engineering teams, Problem Management, Change Enablement, Vendor Management (VMO), suppliers, and senior stakeholders. Through these partnerships, you will strengthen DCO and PSO integration, improve operational handovers, and convert incident learning into sustainable service improvements.
* Lead and coordinate Major Incidents and P1 incidents from declaration through service restoration and formal closure, maintaining a clear command structure, accurate situational awareness, and momentum toward recovery.
* Rapidly evaluate technical, customer, and business impact; validate priority; initiate the appropriate Major Incident or crisis pathway; and ensure compliance with agreed SLAs, OLAs, customer commitments, and escalation procedures.
* Mobilize and coordinate DCO, PSO, SRE, Product, Engineering, vendor, supplier, and specialist resolver teams, establishing clear accountabilities, time\-bound actions, dependencies, and escalation points.
* Establish and facilitate technical, customer, and management bridges, keeping discussions outcome\-focused, recording decisions and actions, challenging stalled progress, and escalating risks, resource gaps, or conflicting priorities.
* Deliver accurate, concise, and timely communications for customers, operations, senior leadership, and executives, clearly presenting impact, recovery actions, workarounds, risks, assumptions, estimated next updates, and service status.
* Maintain a complete and auditable incident record in the ITSM platform, including business impact, chronology, ownership, decisions, evidence, communications, recovery validation, links to related Problems and Changes, and closure details.
* Produce high\-quality Post\-Major Incident Reports (PMIRs), executive summaries, and post\-incident review packs; facilitate blameless learning reviews that identify control gaps, contributing factors, and practical opportunities for improvement.
* Coordinate Root Cause Analysis and Corrective and Preventive Actions (CAPA) with Problem Management and technical owners, ensuring actions are risk\-based, measurable, assigned, due\-dated, tracked, and closed only after effectiveness is verified.
* Analyze incident performance and trends, including MTTA, MTTR, SLA compliance, repeat incidents, business impact, communication timeliness, escalation quality, action ageing, and customer feedback; translate insights into prioritized improvement plans.
* Advance the maturity of Incident Management through playbooks, escalation matrices, knowledge articles, templates, simulations, training, automation opportunities, governance reviews, and stronger integration across DCO, PSO, SRE, CSO, VMO, and Service Practices.


Qualifications:
**EXPERIENCE**
--------------


Preferably 2 to 5 years of relevant experience in a customer\-focused service or support role within a large\-scale enterprise environment. Experience should include Customer Support, Service Desk, Help Desk, Call Centre, Incident Management, Service Operations, NOC, Command Centre, or IT Operations. **NICE TO HAVE*** ITIL 4 Foundation/Practitioner, SRE, Agile, DevOps, Lean, Six Sigma, or related Service Management certifications.
* Experience supporting mission\-critical environments such as aviation, travel technology, telecommunications, cloud services, managed infrastructure, SaaS platforms, or financial services, with exposure to executive communications, crisis management, and business continuity processes.
* Hands\-on experience with ServiceNow or similar ITSM platforms, observability and monitoring tools (Splunk, Dynatrace, etc), operational analytics, AI Ops, and Incident Management transformation initiatives.
  

Candidates should demonstrate strong customer engagement skills and practical experience supporting a broad range of services and products at intermediate to advanced levels. Experience or working knowledge of airline and travel industry operations, applications, and customer service environments is highly desirable.**KNOWLEDGE \& SKILLS**
-----------------------

**IT Service Management Knowledge**

* Advanced practical understanding of ITIL\-based Incident and Major Incident Management, including interfaces with Problem, Change, Event, Knowledge, Service Level and Continual Improvement practices.
* Understanding of service management governance, SLAs/OLAs, operational acceptance, service transition, risk and control frameworks.
* Proficiency with enterprise ITSM platforms such as ServiceNow or equivalent, collaboration tools, reporting dashboards and knowledge repositories.
* Strong command of RCA methods including 5 Whys, fishbone analysis, fault\-tree thinking, timeline analysis and contributory\-factor analysis.

**Technical Knowledge**


* Broad operational understanding of enterprise networks, LAN/WAN, MPLS, SD\-WAN, VPN, DNS, load balancing, firewalls and connectivity services.
* Working knowledge of cloud, data centre, virtualization, compute, storage, databases, middleware, messaging, APIs, identity, monitoring and application support.
* Ability to interpret monitoring alerts, logs, service dependencies, transaction flows, change records and technical recovery plans.
* Awareness of cybersecurity incident interfaces, business continuity, disaster recovery and regulated or safety\-critical service environments.
* Ability to lead technical specialists effectively without being the deepest subject\-matter expert in every technology domain.

**Management \& Interpersonal Skills**

* Exceptional incident leadership, command\-and\-control, facilitation and prioritization under time pressure.
* Clear written and verbal communication, including executive summaries and customer\-facing updates.
* Strong analytical reasoning, structured problem solving, attention to evidence and disciplined decision\-making.
* Influencing, negotiation and conflict\-resolution capability across teams with competing priorities and no direct reporting relationship.

**PROFESSION COMPETENCIES**
---------------------------

**Customer \& Business Orientation:** Understands business impact and balances technical recovery, operational risk, contractual commitments and customer experience.

**Operational Excellence:** Applies repeatable controls, accurate records, measurable standards and evidence\-based governance.

GHX is building a cutting\-edge **LLM\-powered document understanding platform** focused on classification, structured data extraction, and intelligent orchestration at scale.  

This is a **high\-impact AI engineering role** where you will own the full lifecycle—from **problem framing to production deployment**. Initially, you will focus on **prompt engineering and evaluation systems**, building the quality foundation for AI performance. Over time, the role expands into **agent orchestration, system architecture, and migration of rule\-based systems to LLM\-driven pipelines**. A strong foundation in **software engineering (5\+ years)** is essential. This role demands engineering rigor across both **traditional system design and AI system behavior**.  

  

**Core Responsibilities**  

**1\. Prompt Engineering**
* Design prompts for diverse document classification and extraction tasks
* Treat prompts as **formal specifications** (precise, structured, and edge\-case\-aware)
* Develop few\-shot, chain\-of\-thought, and structured output templates
* Manage prompt lifecycle: versioning, testing, and rollback

**2\. LLM Output Evaluation**
* Create and maintain ground truth datasets
* Build automated evaluation pipelines (precision, recall, field\-level accuracy)
* Identify and resolve conceptually incorrect outputs despite surface correctness

**3\. AI Agent Orchestration**
* Design multi\-agent workflows for document processing
* Implement tool\-use patterns and integrate MCP servers
* Optimize orchestration for scale and efficiency

**4\. Software Engineering**
* Develop production\-grade APIs and backend services
* Apply **Clean Architecture / DDD principles**
* Write maintainable, testable Python code
* Contribute to CI/CD, deployment, and observability systems

**5\. Stakeholder Collaboration**
* Act as a bridge between business stakeholders and AI systems
* Translate product requirements into technical architectures
* Communicate system behavior, limitations, and quality metrics clearly

  

  

  

**Required Skills \& Experience**
* 5\+ years of software engineering experience (Python preferred)
* Advanced **prompt engineering and LLM evaluation expertise**
* Experience with **ground truth dataset design**
* Hands\-on experience with LLM APIs (OpenAI, Anthropic, Azure AI)
* AI agent orchestration experience
* Strong understanding of **Clean Architecture / DDD principles**
* REST API development
* Version control (Git), CI/CD practices, containerization
* Experience with AWS or similar cloud platforms

**Role Evolution**  

**Now (0–6 months): Prompt Engineering \& Evaluation**
* Design and refine prompts for classification and data extraction
* Build ground truth datasets and evaluation pipelines
* Establish accuracy benchmarks and quality baselines

**Mid\-Term (6–12 months): Agent Orchestration \& Pipeline Design**
* Develop multi\-agent document processing pipelines
* Integrate MCP\-based tools and external service interfaces
* Orchestrate parallel AI workflows

**Long\-Term (12\+ months): Platform Architecture \& Ownership**
* Own the end\-to\-end document intelligence architecture
* Lead migration from rule\-based to LLM\-powered systems
* Define engineering standards and best practices

description:
At Boeing, we innovate and collaborate to make the world a better place. We’re committed to fostering an environment for every teammate that’s welcoming, respectful and inclusive, with great opportunity for professional growth. Find your future with us.


**Overview**


As a leading global aerospace company, Boeing develops, manufactures and services commercial airplanes, defense products and space systems for customers in more than 150 countries. As a top U.S. exporter, the company leverages the talents of a global supplier base to advance economic opportunity, sustainability and community impact. Boeing’s team is committed to innovating for the future, leading with sustainability, and cultivating a culture based on the company’s core values of safety, quality and integrity.


**Technology for today and tomorrow**


The Boeing India Engineering \& Technology Center (BIETC) is a 5500\+ engineering workforce that contributes to global aerospace growth. Our engineers deliver cutting\-edge R\&D, innovation, and high\-quality engineering work in global markets, and leverage new\-age technologies such as AI/ML, IIoT, Cloud, Model\-Based Engineering, and Additive Manufacturing, shaping the future of aerospace.Boeing Defence India (BDI) is Boeing’s regional defence business focused on sustainment, modifications, training, and indigenous capability development for Indian defence platforms. Supporting multiple military programs and government partners, BDI operates across several sites in India and is scaling to deliver local supply‑chain, MRO, and engineering capabilities through strategic partnerships and co‑development.


**People\-driven culture**


At Boeing, we believe creativity and innovation thrives when every employee is trusted, empowered, and has the flexibility to choose, grow, learn, and explore. We offer variable arrangements depending upon business and customer needs, and professional pursuits that offer greater flexibility in the way our people work. We also believe that collaboration, frequent team engagements, and face\-to\-face meetings bring together different perspectives and thoughts – enabling every voice to be heard and every perspective to be respected. No matter where or how our teammates work, we are committed to positively shaping people’s careers and being thoughtful about employee wellbeing.


With us, you can create and contribute to what matters most in your career, community, country, and world. Join us in powering the progress of global aerospace.


**Position Overview**


The IT Business Partner (Senior Manager, L level) will act as the strategic conduit between BDI business leadership and Enterprise IT (IDT\&S / BGS). The role owns in‑country IT prioritization, RAA definition, and the delivery of IT services (ERP, MRO, PLM enablement support, training/simulation platforms) to enable BDI’s localization, MRO and supply‑chain objectives.


This role will be based out of Delhi, India.


**Position Responsibilities:**


* Serve as the primary IT strategic lead for BDI: define priorities, represent BDI in IDT\&S governance, and communicate IT roadmaps and budget needs.
* Produce concise decision briefs, budgets and business cases to secure funding and resource commitments.
* Own RAA, support model and escalation matrices for localized systems (ERP, MRO, training/simulation) and coordinate end‑to‑end L1/L2 support with Enterprise IT Teams
* Lead SAP sustainment \& change capability for BDI in partnership with the SAP COE and partners
* Shape the localized IT strategy and roadmap for PLM, MRO and ERP alignment to business priorities, ensuring integration efforts deliver operational value.
* Own end‑to‑end delivery governance for IT platform enablement initiatives, including pilot approval, program gating, and assurance of business readiness and outcomes.
* Establish enterprise‑grade data and integration governance, setting policies, cadence, and accountability to maintain a reliable digital thread across engineering, maintenance, and supply‑chain systems.
* Lead talent and capability planning for in‑country IT, defining organizational design, resourcing priorities, and capability development to optimize sustainability.

Employer will not sponsor applicants for employment visa status.

* 8\+ years relevant experience in IT delivery, ERP/PLM/MRO programs, IT service management, or equivalent combination of education and experience.
* Demonstrated experience working with SAP (S/4\), PLM/MRO programs, or large enterprise system implementations.
* Strong stakeholder management and governance experience; able to chair change boards and drive decisions.
* Excellent communication skills and ability to work across distributed teams and vendors.

**Preferred Qualifications (Desired Skills/Experience ) :**


* Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Engineering, Information Systems, or related discipline.
* Prior experience in defence / aerospace sustainment, MRO operations, or working with multi‑platform delivery centers.
* Experience with Teamcenter/Opcenter or GOLDesp implementations and integrations.
* Hands‑on knowledge of integration patterns (API/ESB/iPaaS), master data governance, and ITIL service operations.
* Experience leading cross‑functional change management and adoption programs.
